question: What supreme Eye of Śiva and Śakti is honored as illumination and total power?
premises: The Eye is described as illumination-natured
The Eye belongs to Śiva and Śakti and is supreme
inference: We bow to that supreme Eye of Śiva and Śakti, whose nature is illumination and which holds all power.
plain_english: We bow to that supreme Eye of Śiva and Śakti, whose nature is illumination and which possesses all power.
